title: Soul Feast #28: Spiritual Partnership and the Law of Attraction
excerpt: In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav deepens the exploration of the Law of Attraction by examining its profound relationship with spiritual partnership.
bodyHtml:
In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav deepens the exploration of the Law of Attraction by examining its profound relationship with spiritual partnership.

As humanity undergoes a monumental transformation into a multi-sensory species, Gary shares how the old world of external power is dissolving, making space for the creation of authentic power—an alignment of the personality with the soul. 

He offers insights into how our energy shapes not only our experiences but also the people we attract, especially in our most intimate relationships.

Gary explains that while many spiritual partnerships may appear to be rooted in romance or common interests, their true purpose lies in mutual spiritual growth. 

The Law of Attraction brings together individuals with similar energies—whether conscious or unconscious—so that they can learn to grow through love instead of fear.

This shift from fear-based to love-based dynamics is central to evolving authentically in the new consciousness.

The solution to creating authentic power lies in cultivating emotional awareness, making responsible choices, and consulting your intuition. These practices form the foundation for conscious, aligned relationships – spiritual partnerships.

Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

    • (00:00) — Why the Law of Attraction is more than “thoughts create things”—it’s energy attracting like energy
    • (03:12) — How the old consciousness relied on the five senses and intellect—and why that no longer serves us
    • (06:45) — What it means to create authentic power through emotional awareness, responsible choice, and intuition
    • (11:10) — Why spiritual partnerships often feel intense—and what their deeper purpose truly is
    • (15:28) — How the Law of Attraction operates unconsciously when fear leads—and how conscious love transforms it
    • (19:45) — The key difference between authentic power and harmlessness—and how real spiritual growth begins
